metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Hardware Profile (v1.3)
metadata.subtitle: Execution Substrate Descriptor for RTT • Regimes • Operators • Paradox • Consent • Collapse
metadata.description: Defines the hardware execution profile, substrate class, RTT capability ranges, paradox gating, consent gating, collapse readiness, and performance envelope for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Hardware profile defines the execution substrate; authoritative values come from substrate.json, runtime.json, operators.json, regimes.json, and spec‑008.

constraints: Non-agentic substrate forbidden for harmonic and resolution.
Substrate MUST support paradox density evaluation.
Substrate MUST support lattice stability evaluation.

paradox_capability_range.notes: Hardware MUST support paradox evaluation for harmonic regime.

hardware_rules: Hardware profile MUST NOT contradict substrate.json.
Hardware profile MUST NOT contradict runtime.json.
Hardware profile MUST NOT contradict operators.json.
Hardware profile MUST NOT contradict regimes.json.
Hardware profile MUST NOT contradict spec‑008.json.
Hardware profile MUST NOT invent measure IDs.
Hardware profile MUST NOT invent paradox types.
Hardware profile MUST NOT invent substrate classes.
